title: Avoiding Peanuts Led To A 13.7% Allergy Rate
hook: Early peanut eating cut allergy rates to 1.9%.
closing: Better evidence reversed old advice, so parents should discuss timing with their doctor.
question: Would you introduce peanut early?

segments.say: Peanut allergy reached 1.4 percent of US children, after earlier avoidance advice became common.
Early peanut eaters had a 1.9 percent allergy rate, overturning advice to avoid exposure.
Diagnoses fell to 0.45 percent after early-introduction guidance, an encouraging shift rather than proof of cause.
